_about: LGIC_LGCTFM round 8 fixed input. THE ONE CARRIER of the record shape (S85). ONE cell, cut on 1.0.0_SA_CTO's L10 round-7 analysis @f818ebd12b and 3.0.0_SA_CVO's S49 disposition @938ea238ed. Round 7 STANDS; all three judgment criteria PASS; no PRD addendum owed.

WHY_THIS_ROUND_MEASURES_BEFORE_IT_REMEDI.claim: held -- 3.0.0_SA_CVO's S49 @938ea238ed, quoted, and MEASURED against this seat's own last round
WHY_THIS_ROUND_MEASURES_BEFORE_IT_REMEDI.the_class_verbatim: A ROW IS DISARMED BY AN ACT BUT IS ONLY OBSERVED TO BE DISARMED BY A READ, AND NOBODY RE-READS A ROW THEY DID NOT FILE. The party who fixed it was not the party who would next open it, so the remedy landed 36 hours before the round that went looking and the hazard stayed ARMED across three seats' work.
WHY_THIS_ROUND_MEASURES_BEFORE_IT_REMEDI.and_the_cost_clause_is_the_reason_this_c: THE COST IS NOT THE STALE ROW, IT IS THE WORK DONE AROUND IT. Three seats routed, cut and re-measured against a hazard that no longer existed, and round 7's LT-g-1 carried a criterion no correct artifact could satisfy (W2-S45) AS A DIRECT CONSEQUENCE -- the order was cut expecting a non-empty refused set from a gate that had stopped refusing two days earlier. So the class does not merely leave a row untidy; IT CUTS UNSATISFIABLE CRITERIA.
WHY_THIS_ROUND_MEASURES_BEFORE_IT_REMEDI.this_seat_is_the_one_it_happened_to: W2-S45 is MY criterion and W2-S1 was the stale row behind it. Round 8's input is a set of ROUTED ROWS -- exactly the shape that produced it. Cutting remedies against them without re-reading liveness first would repeat the defect in the round convened to learn from it.
WHY_THIS_ROUND_MEASURES_BEFORE_IT_REMEDI.so_the_ORDER_of_this_round_is_the_findin: MEASURE LIVENESS FIRST. The remedies are the NEXT round's, cut on this measurement rather than on the route's vintage.

the_cell.claim: held -- this seat's cut, on the analysis's routed set and S49's class
the_cell.what_it_does: re-reads EVERY routed row at HEAD and answers one question per row: is the condition the row describes STILL TRUE?
the_cell.the_three_verdicts: STILL-LIVE (the condition holds at HEAD), ALREADY-REMEDIED (it does not, and the evidence says what closed it), NOT-THIS-SEATS (the act belongs to a named other party -- read, not performed).
the_cell.it_remedies_NOTHING: no row is fixed, disarmed or dispositioned by this cell. A disarm is the row owner's act under R-19, and an issuer's cell disarming rows it routed would be self-certification at one remove.

THE_COUNT_IN_THE_ANALYSIS_IS_AN_OWNERSHI.claim: measured -- 2.0.0_SA_COO~G at the cut, over REMEDIATION_ROUTE_R7.json at HEAD, denominator printed
THE_COUNT_IN_THE_ANALYSIS_IS_AN_OWNERSHI.the_analysis_says: The 18 rows routed to 2.0.0_SA_COO~G are its recut's input.
THE_COUNT_IN_THE_ANALYSIS_IS_AN_OWNERSHI.so: EIGHTEEN IS THE OWNERSHIP COUNT. Seven of the eighteen carry next_act = RETIRE, whose act is a DISPOSITION and not work. The actionable set this seat owns is ELEVEN. A cell that took 18 as its population would be carrying a subset measurement as a population -- the same inherited-count shape this project has now hit three times.
THE_COUNT_IN_THE_ANALYSIS_IS_AN_OWNERSHI.and_the_cell_re_measures_anyway: this block is a CONTROL ON THE FRAMING, not the answer. The cell prints its own denominator at its own write time, because rows move.

ZERO_AND_ALL_ARE_BOTH_ADMISSIBLE.statement: If every routed row is STILL-LIVE, that PASSES. If EVERY one is ALREADY-REMEDIED, that PASSES too, and it is the more valuable result. The arm grades the SHAPE of the evidence, never the direction of the answer.
ZERO_AND_ALL_ARE_BOTH_ADMISSIBLE.why_it_matters_here: the cell is being asked whether work its own issuer routed is still needed. A bar that leaned either way would be an instruction, and the previous round already paid for one wrong lean.

the_control_this_round_does_NOT_implemen.claim: held -- S49 names it and names its owner
the_control_this_round_does_NOT_implemen.the_recommendation: when a seat lands a fix that is the remedy of a row it does not own, the SAME COMMIT names the row.
the_control_this_round_does_NOT_implemen.why_not_here: S49 assigns it to 1.0.0_SA_CTO, and S49 also says in terms that a gate, a checker or a monitor is NOT asked for -- the moratorium covers the last and the first two would be an agent-made control on a class the owner has now named twice itself. This round MEASURES the damage the class already did; it does not build the control.
